# Test: completion omits a branch that collides with another worktree's directory name
setup_workspace bar baz

# Branch bar lives in directory foo, so the directory named bar holds branch baz.
exec grove add --name foo bar
exec grove add --name bar baz

cd $WORK/workspace/main
exec grove __complete switch ''
stdout '^foo\tbar$'
stdout '^bar\tbaz$'

# "bar" as a standalone branch candidate would resolve to the bar directory, which holds baz.
! stdout '^bar$'
stdout '^baz$'
